A0236.title: Robot Black Box & Behavior Audit
A0236.definition: Ensuring robot physical behavior is traceable and accountable via robot black-box logging of the full perception-decision-action chain, on-chain action-log auditing, explainable decisions, and human-in-the-loop.
A0236.description: The robot black box and behavioral audit address the issues of unclear liability attribution and untraceable decision-making processes following physical harm incidents involving robots, drawing on the concept of aviation black boxes. First, the robot black box records the full-chain logs of perception inputs, model decisions, planned trajectories, and executed actions during robot operation, enabling post-incident reconstruction of the decision-making process. Second, action logs are subjected to on-chain auditing, where critical action logs are uploaded to a chain or written to tamper-proof storage to prevent post-incident tampering by manufacturers or operators. Third, explainable decisions require VLA/LLM decision outputs to include interpretable justifications, facilitating incident investigations. Fourth, human-in-the-loop retains a human confirmation step for high-risk decisions, clarifying the boundaries of human-machine responsibility. This measure is a core governance response following liability disputes in incidents such as the Knightscope K5 collision and the Tesla Autopilot fatality. It works in conjunction with A0072 (Algorithm Audit Mechanism), where the latter governs general algorithm auditing, while this measure focuses on the traceability of physical behaviors of embodied devices. It serves as a key support for high-risk AI obligations under the EU AI Act and China's robot liability legislation.
A0236.limitation: Full-chain logging generates large data volumes, leading to high storage and transmission costs. On-chain auditing introduces latency, making real-time on-chain recording for all actions impractical. Explainable decisions may risk exposing model intellectual property. Human-in-the-loop reduces the degree of automation, creating tension with the autonomy objectives of embodied intelligence.
